import json, subprocess, time, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
from stress import mk_trace
rng = random.Random(9)
K=8
fields=[{"name":"n%d"%i,"type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":10} for i in range(4)]
def tree(depth):
    if depth==4: return {"field":rng.choice(fields)["name"],"at":"$"}
    if rng.random()<0.6: return {"add":[tree(depth+1),tree(depth+1)]}
    return {"scale":rng.randint(1,4),"term":tree(depth+1)}
def count(t):
    ks=set(t)
    if ks in ({"field","at"},{"const","type"},{"aggregate","field","from","to"}): return 1
    if ks=={"scale","term"}: return 1+count(t["term"])
    return 1+count(t["add"][0])+count(t["add"][1])
atoms=[]
for i in range(20):
    # force evaluation of all 8 bindings: left very negative, right positive
    left={"scale":-1000,"term":tree(1)}
    right=tree(1)
    atoms.append({"quantifier":"all","from":0,"to":7,
                  "predicate":{"cmp":"le","left":left,"right":right}})
print('nodes/atom', count(atoms[0]['predicate']['left'])+count(atoms[0]['predicate']['right']))
def rand_row(): return [rng.randint(0,10) for _ in fields]
train=[mk_trace("tr%d"%i,"s%d"%(i%16),[rand_row() for _ in range(258)]) for i in range(16)]
probes=[mk_trace("pr0","s0",[rand_row() for _ in range(128)])]
queries=[mk_trace("q0","s0",[rand_row() for _ in range(1031)])]
req={"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,
     "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
     "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}
text=json.dumps(req)
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=text.encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%(time.time()-t0),'in',len(text))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode()); print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']))
print(p.stderr.decode()[:300])
EOF
